*   # USD/JPY weekly outlook: US inflation threatens to break the stalemate

    [From forex.com](https://www.forex.com/en-us/news-and-analysis/usd-jpy-weekly-outlook-us-inflation-threatens-to-break-the-stalemate/)

    [![](https://assets.faireconomy.media/nfs/npd/2022/09/14/npd_21_58_29.v2.png)](https://www.forex.com/en-us/news-and-analysis/usd-jpy-weekly-outlook-us-inflation-threatens-to-break-the-stalemate/)

    https://www.forex.com/en-us/news-and-analysis/usd-jpy-weekly-outlook-us-inflation-threatens-to-break-the-stalemate/

    US inflation data dominates the week ahead for USD/JPY, with Wednesday's CPI and Thursday's PPI reports likely to influence Treasury yields and broader risk appetite. With markets pricing more than three Fed rate hikes by the middle of next year, the onus remains on inflation to stay relatively elevated and sticky to justify those expectations. However, the recent deterioration in USD/JPY's traditionally strong relationship with US Treasury yields suggests the reaction in riskier assets may be just as important as movements in yields themselves, complicating the outlook for the pair.
